casual_leave.title: Casual Leave
casual_leave.description: Employees are entitled to 12 casual leaves per calendar year.

sick_leave.title: Sick Leave
sick_leave.description: Employees receive 10 sick leaves every year. Medical certificate is required for more than 3 consecutive days.

earned_leave.title: Earned Leave
earned_leave.description: Earned leave accumulates monthly and can be carried forward up to 30 days.

probation.title: Probation Policy
probation.description: Employees on probation cannot avail casual leave unless approved by HR.

work_from_home.title: Work From Home
work_from_home.description: Employees may work from home up to two days per week with manager approval.

grievance.title: Grievance Policy
grievance.description: All employee grievances are confidential and reviewed by HR within five business days.

attendance.title: Attendance
attendance.description: Employees must complete at least 8 working hours per day.
